construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H24-005 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2024), status Under Review: "Site Development Permit to allow the demolition of the existing house, the removal of 5 ordinance-size trees and 16 non-ordinance-size trees, and the construction of one 5-unit townhome building and one 6-unit townhome building on a 0.37-acre site."

City of San Jose permit T24-001 (Tentative Map, folder year 2024), status Under Review: "Vesting Tentative Map to allow subdivision of one lot into 12 lots including 11 lots for townhome units and one lot for common area on a 0.37-acre site."

The 2020 staff report describes the site, at the southwest corner of Hayes Avenue and Lean Avenue, as occupied by a one-story 1,638 sq ft single-family house, with a General Plan designation of Mixed Use Neighborhood. The 2019 applications sought to rezone it from R-1-1 to R-2 and subdivide it into three lots.
